comparison.objective: Roll a wide cabinet shelf through a narrower face-frame opening and lower it onto four pins.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual reorientation of a large rigid body through constrained geometry and precise support placement.
comparison.success_condition: Shelf level and seated on all four pins, cabinet undamaged, hands released, and stable.
comparison.reason: Constrained large-body reorientation and placement are unrelated to selective granular passage through many apertures.
